name: Wulften am Harz (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and light blue in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wulften am Harz (a white wolf on blue with a small shield).
history: The flag is light blue-white-light blue striped in the ratio 1:2:1 with the arms at the centre.

features.role: Wulften am Harz arms — white wolf on blue
